name: Nike
special_rule: Paid deals below club level 10 are selective
reality_note: Open team-uniform program; elite paid partnerships are much more selective.

name: Adidas
reality_note: Broad teamwear availability and global premium-club portfolio.

name: Puma
reality_note: Worldwide teamwear and a broad professional portfolio from smaller clubs to global teams.

name: Macron
reality_note: Major European teamwear specialist with more than 100 professional clubs, teams and federations.

name: Hummel
reality_note: Strong football heritage, broad European club availability and a clear Nordic core.

name: Joma
reality_note: Very broad teamwear catalogue for clubs and federations with strong Iberian and international activity.

name: Castore
reality_note: Professional-club focused and expansion-oriented; less evidence of a fully open grassroots teamwear network.

name: Kappa
reality_note: Established professional portfolio plus Kappa4Team club products.

name: Umbro
reality_note: Teamwear is explicitly positioned down the football pyramid, alongside professional partnerships.

name: Mizuno
reality_note: Open club/school/university teamwear and a selective European professional expansion.

name: New Balance
reality_note: Open custom team sports program; football club portfolio is smaller and more selective than the big three.

name: Kelme
reality_note: Strong Iberian roots with substantial Asian federation and club activity.

name: Craft
reality_note: Teamwear explicitly covers clubs and athletes at all levels; strongest natural fit is Northern Europe.

name: Capelli
reality_note: Global multi-sports teamwear brand with strong grassroots, academy and lower-professional activity.

name: JAKO
reality_note: More than 250,000 teams worldwide, from grassroots to top professional football; strongest in DACH/Central Europe.

name: Reebok
reach_profile: Global brand / rare current football deals
reality_note: High brand recognition but currently very limited club-football presence; useful as a rare aggressive challenger.

name: Erreà
reality_note: European technical teamwear specialist serving every level and multiple professional clubs.

name: uhlsport
reality_note: Open teamwear from amateur levels upward, with selective professional club supply.

name: Erima
reality_note: Open to amateur clubs and professional teams; strongest natural market is DACH and neighboring Europe.

name: EA7
reality_note: Modeled as an exclusive special case, reflecting the continuing Napoli-specific football partnership.

name: Lotto
special_rule: Current football activity lower than historical brand prestige
reality_note: Historic football brand with team products and selected partnerships; modeled below its historical peak.

name: Saller
reality_note: German football team-sport supplier aimed strongly at clubs and squads with long-available team lines.
